Questions people ask first

How long does it last?

[7 to 10] days, fading a little each day. Swimming, long baths and exfoliating shorten it.

Will it look orange?

No. The colour is matched to your skin tone, and the darker guide colour you walk out in rinses away.

Do I need a patch test?

Yes, at least [24] hours before your first tan, and again if it has been more than [3] months.

When do I rinse it off?

After [X] hours for the Signature, [X] for the Express. Cool water, no soap, then pat dry.

What should I wear?

Loose, dark clothes you can get straight back into. Underwear is your choice and Ashley will talk you through it.

What if I need to cancel?

[Give 24 hours' notice to move or cancel. Later than that and the tan is charged in full.]

Before you come

  • Exfoliate and shave or wax [24 to 48] hours before, not on the day.
  • No moisturiser, oil, deodorant, perfume or make-up on the day.
  • Loose dark clothes you can get straight back into.

After you leave

  • Keep your skin dry for [X] hours, then rinse in cool water with no soap.
  • Moisturise every day to keep it even as it fades.
  • Skip swimming and long hot baths while you want it to last.
